text: All regular road** generation 3** coverage in Ghana was made with a unique Google car. It has a visible roof rack with a piece of **black tape** on the right end of the front bar. In addition, the hood of the car is usually visible, showing a street view car wrapping that features a **red rectangle** and some other recognizable elements. Normally, this unique car is all you need to identify Ghana.
NOTE: Several natural reserves were covered with different unique cars.
text_zh: 迦納所有常規的**第三代**道路街景覆蓋都是由一台獨特的 Google 車所拍攝。它有明顯的車頂架，且前車頂架右端貼有一段**黑色膠帶**。此外，通常可以看到車頭蓋，上面有街景車身包膜，包含一個**紅色長方形**和其他容易辨識的元素。通常，這台獨特的車就是你識別迦納所需的全部線索。
註：幾個自然保護區使用了不同的獨特車輛進行拍攝。

text: Generation 4 coverage in Ghana was taken using a **grey** or white **pickup truck** with an antenna in the front. The truck will be either fully or partially **blurred **most of the time.
text_zh: 迦納的第四代街景覆蓋是使用一台前方裝有天線的**灰色**或白色**皮卡車**（pickup truck）拍攝的。這台卡車在大多數時間裡會被完全或部分**打上馬賽克**。

text: Ghana uses **white** plates on normal vehicles, and **yellow** plates for commercial vehicles. They can be long or short. Because commercial vehicles are really common, you will often see a mix of both plate colours.
NOTE: Nigeria has similar white plates, but a green tint should be visible, which helps differentiate them.
text_zh: 迦納的一般車輛使用**白色**車牌，商用車則使用**黃色**車牌。車牌可以是長形或短形。因為商用車非常普遍，你經常會看到兩種車牌顏色混雜在一起。
註：奈及利亞也有類似的白色車牌，但應該能看出帶有一點綠色色調，這有助於區分它們。

text: Ghana is mostly flat with **red soil**, however hills and mountains can be seen in some regions. **Tropical **vegetation is very common, and palms are common especially toward the south.
text_zh: 迦納的地形大多平坦且有著**紅色土壤**，但在某些地區可以看到丘陵和山脈。**熱帶**植被非常普遍，棕櫚樹也很常見，特別是在南部地區。

text: Taxis in Ghana typically have **multicoloured** body panels. The fenders and quarter panels are always coloured orange-yellow.
text_zh: 迦納的出租車車身面板通常是**多種顏色**的。擋泥板和車身後側面板總是呈現橘黃色。

text: Road lines in Ghana are **always white**. However, many paved roads do not have road lines at all.
text_zh: 迦納的道路標線**永遠是白色的**。然而，許多鋪面道路完全沒有道路標線。

text: Ghana typically uses **wooden **poles with **3 insulators** on a metallic crossbar.
NOTE: Kenya has a similar [pole](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Wn9yQGnjHhFSLjG37).
text_zh: 迦納通常使用金屬橫樑上有 **3 個絕緣體**的**木製**電線桿。
註：肯亞也有類似的[電線桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Wn9yQGnjHhFSLjG37)。

text: Ghana is a patriotic** **country, and you can often see things painted in the national **flag’s colours**: red, yellow, green, and sometimes including the black star.
text_zh: 迦納是一個充滿愛國情操的**國家**，你經常可以看到漆成**國旗顏色**（紅色、黃色、綠色，有時包含黑星）的物品。

text: **Black and white **striped signposts in Ghana are typically seen in cities. On rural roads, you will mostly see classic, non-painted, metal signposts.
NOTE: Black and white signposts can be seen in other countries as well. Make sure to look at other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 迦納的**黑白**相間路標通常出現在城市中。在鄉村道路上，你主要會看到傳統、未上漆的金屬路標。
註：黑白路標在其他國家也能看到。在作猜測之前，務必觀察其他線索。

text: The coverage in Ghana is **limited **and easy to memorize, as most of it was taken on its main roads and in major cities. The most dense coverage is located in the south, around the cities of Accra and Kumasi.
text_zh: 迦納的街景覆蓋**有限**且容易記住，因為大部分的街景都是在其主要幹道和大城市中拍攝的。最密集的街景覆蓋位於南部，也就是阿克拉（Accra）和庫馬西（Kumasi）等城市周邊。

text: The majority of generation 4 coverage is close to Accra or Kumasi, with only a few major roads being covered.
text_zh: 大多數第四代街景覆蓋都在阿克拉或庫馬西附近，只有少數主要道路有街景覆蓋。

text: This map shows the distribution of **paved and unpaved roads** across the country.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這張地圖顯示了全國各地**鋪面道路與未鋪面道路**的分佈情況。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Ghana features 3 distinct types of tape on the google car:

In the southwest, you can find the ‘[unpeeled tape](https://www.google.com/maps/@5.0031389,-2.025501,3a,17.5y,227.34h,35.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s62SoTE21Q6VCvYwLPIrzhA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)’, which is essentially a mostly **intact tape**, which is not peeling off.
In the east and north, you can find the ‘[peeled tape](https://goo.gl/maps/aCFqaQwVS6q6zmqh7)’, which unlike the ‘unpeeled tape’, is slightly **peeled off**.
North of Kumasi, and west of Tamale, you can find this ‘[scotched tape](https://goo.gl/maps/zZadCxUZeGzku5QS8)’, which has two distinct **white spots** on the left side of the tape.
text_zh: 迦納的 Google 車上有 3 種不同類型的膠帶：
在西南部，你可以找到『[未撕開的膠帶](https://www.google.com/maps/@5.0031389,-2.025501,3a,17.5y,227.34h,35.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s62SoTE21Q6VCvYwLPIrzhA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)』，這基本上是一條大致**完好且未剝落**的膠帶。
在東部和北部，你可以找到『[剝落的膠帶](https://goo.gl/maps/aCFqaQwVS6q6zmqh7)』，它與『未撕開的膠帶』不同，是有點**剝落**開來的。
在庫馬西以北、塔馬利（Tamale）以西，你可以找到這條『[有膠帶痕跡的膠帶](https://goo.gl/maps/zZadCxUZeGzku5QS8)』，它的膠帶左側有兩個明顯的**白色光斑**。

text: Northern Ghana features a **savannah** landscape, which can be identified by its dry soil and less dense vegetation.
text_zh: 迦納北部具有**熱帶草原**景觀，其特徵是乾燥的土壤和較稀疏的植被。

text: **Tall mountain ranges **in Ghana are typically seen near Lake Volta in the highlighted area.
NOTE: Mountain ranges to the east are more common in the area near Togo.
text_zh: 迦納的**高山山脈**通常出現在沃爾特湖（Lake Volta）附近的突顯區域。
註：東部的山脈在靠近多哥（Togo）的地區更常見。

text: **Dense forests** in Ghana are typically found in the southwest and east. You will usually see many naturally occurring palm** **trees, making the two regions recognizable.
text_zh: 迦納的**茂密森林**通常分佈在西南部和東部。你通常會看到許多自然生長的棕櫚**樹**，這使得這兩個地區極具辨識度。

text: **Tall palm trees** are commonly found** **along the coast. Most of them are located in the west.
text_zh: **高大的棕櫚樹**常見於**沿海地區**。它們大多位於西部。

text: Most **unpaved roads** in a **dry savannah** landscape are found north of Wa, as well as near the town itself.
NOTE: The other unpaved roads in northern Ghana are the Yendi-Nkwanta road in the east, and part of the Salaga-Tamale road, which has very distinct soil. See the tips below.
text_zh: **乾燥熱帶草原**景觀中的大多數**未鋪面道路**都位於瓦鎮（Wa）以北，以及該城鎮本身附近。
註：迦納北部的其他未鋪面道路包括東部的延迪-恩寬塔（Yendi-Nkwanta）公路，以及薩拉加-塔馬利（Salaga-Tamale）公路的一部分，該路段具有非常獨特的土壤。請參閱下方的提示。

text: The road connecting the town of Sawla with the N10 has very crisp,** new road lines**. Most of the road runs in a general east-west direction, through a lush savannah landscape. The middle line can be solid or dashed.
NOTE: There are a couple of other roads with crisp road lines like these, however these tend to have a different road angle or landscape.
text_zh: 連接索瓦鎮（Sawla）和 N10 公路的道路有非常清晰的**新道路標線**。這條路大致呈東西走向，穿過鬱鬱蔥蔥的熱帶草原景觀。中間的標線可以是實線或虛線。
註：還有其他幾條道路也有像這樣清晰的道路標線，但這些道路通常有不同的道路角度或景觀。

text: The Salaga-Tamale road up to Kpalbusi is a dirt road with very moody **overcast **coverage. The soil tends to be **very dark**, with a purple or brown** **tinge to it. The road also has a unique tropical savannah feel. The soil is most dark near the town of Salaga.
NOTE: Unpaved roads with overcast coverage and a savannah landscape can be found in other places. The unique aspect of this road is the dark purplish brown soil and the especially dark cloud cover.
text_zh: 通往克帕爾布西（Kpalbusi）的薩拉加-塔馬利公路是一條泥土路，有著非常陰暗的**陰天**街景覆蓋。土壤往往**非常黑暗**，帶有紫色或棕色的**色調**。這條路也帶有獨特的熱帶草原風情。土壤在薩拉加鎮附近最黑。
註：帶有陰天街景覆蓋和熱帶草原景觀的未鋪面道路在其他地方也能找到。這條路的獨特之處在於其帶有紫褐色的土壤以及特別陰暗的雲層覆蓋。

text: The road between Nkwanta and Domanko is **unpaved**, with a **powerline** close to the road to your east or northeast. The road itself runs in a general SE-NW direction, through a lush savannah landscape that is typical of central Ghana.

NOTE: In urban areas, there can be a powerline on both sides of the road. In addition, a section of the Salaga-Tamale road has a powerline to the east as well, but the darker soil and moody cloud cover makes it distinguishable.
text_zh: 恩寬塔（Nkwanta）和多曼科（Domanko）之間的道路是**未鋪面道路**，道路東側或東北側緊鄰著**高壓電線**。道路本身大致呈東南-西北走向，穿過迦納中部典型的鬱鬱蔥蔥的熱帶草原景觀。
註：在市區，道路兩側都可能設有高壓電線。此外，薩拉加-塔馬利公路的一段路東側也有高壓電線，但較暗的土壤和陰沉的雲層覆蓋使其得以區分。

text: On a section of the N2 east of Lake Volta, you can often see a **ridgeline to your southeast**, somewhat close to the road. The road itself also has a distinct angle, running in a general SW-NE direction. The sky is very overcast and grey.
text_zh: 在沃爾特湖以東的 N2 公路的一段上，你經常可以看到**東南側有一道山脊**，距離道路有些近。道路本身也有一個明顯的角度，大致呈西南-東北走向。天空非常陰沉且呈現灰色。

text: The coastal area just **east of Accra**, especially on the N1, has a distinct landscape: it is very flat and wide open, with significantly less vegetation than the rest of southern Ghana. Some parts can look somewhat dry.
text_zh: **阿克拉以東**的沿海地區，特別是在 N1 公路上，有著獨特的景觀：地勢非常平坦且開闊，植被比迦納南部其他地區明顯少得多。有些部分看起來可能有點乾燥。

text: The section of the N1 road near the border town of Elubo is **very new**: it has dark and unblemished asphalt, a very crisp-looking middle line, and no outer lines. The vegetation is dense and occasionally features palm trees.
NOTE: This new road surface continues until the town of Azuleti. The middle line can be dashed or solid. Near Azuleti, the road does not have a middle line.
text_zh: 靠近邊境城鎮埃盧博（Elubo）的 N1 公路段**非常新**：它有著黑暗且無瑕疵的柏油路面、看起來非常清晰的中間標線，且沒有外側標線。植被茂密，偶爾夾雜著棕櫚樹。
註：這段新的路面一直延伸到阿祖萊蒂（Azuleti）鎮。中間標線可以是虛線或實線。靠近阿祖萊蒂時，道路沒有中間標線。

text: The **Keta Lagoon** in the southeast of Ghana can be seen on the road that runs along it, with the lake being most visible in the northern section. You can sometimes see grey rocks on the side of the road. The soil is quite sandy in comparison to the rest of the country, and it should have a coastal feel.
text_zh: 迦納東南部的**科塔潟湖**（Keta Lagoon）可以從沿著它延伸的道路上看到，湖泊在北部地區最為明顯。你 manchmal（有時）可以在路邊看到灰色岩石。與該國其他地區相比，土壤相當沙質，並且應該帶有沿海的風情。

text: Several nature reserves and sanctuaries have this unique car. A **white** car and side **mirrors **will be visible instead of the regular car, however, the ‘Ghana tape’ will still be there.
text_zh: 幾個自然保護區和野生動物保護區有這種獨特的車輛。將會看到**白色**車輛和車側**後視鏡**，而不是一般的車輛，但「迦納膠帶」仍然會在那裡。

text: The Ankasa Game Reserve has a unique Google car. The entire front of the Google car **can be seen,** with only the actual camera blurred. The roof of the car will have a street view vinyl and the ‘Ghana tape’ will be present.
text_zh: 安卡薩野生動物保護區（Ankasa Game Reserve）有一台獨特的 Google 車。整台 Google 車的車頭**都可以被看到，**只有實際的相機鏡頭被打了馬賽克。車頂上會有街景車身貼膜，且「迦納膠帶」也會出現。

text: The Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary has a unique Google car. The ‘Ghana tape’ and roof rack will **not **be visible however, the **black right side mirror** will be slightly visible just outside the blur.
NOTE: The red soil and surrounding vegetation should still be good clues for the country, despite the lack of the typical car meta associated with Ghana.
text_zh: 波本費馬猴子保護區（Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary）有一台獨特的 Google 車。「迦納膠帶」和車頂架將**不會**被看到，不過**黑色右側後視鏡**會在馬賽克外圍微微露出。
註：儘管缺乏與迦納相關的典型車輛特徵，但紅色的土壤和周圍的植被仍然是該國很好的線索。
